boundedScope: Actual new whole bilingual a47 body, four full current curricular contracts, P8 content reuse, both complete independent cases and the actual fair30/18rubric. Country/course applicability, view/mandatory-closure, source/semantic fingerprint and LayerA integration remain separate.

individualFullContractDecisions.wholeGoalContractDe: Die lernende Person kann ethische Modelle auf Globalisierungsfragen anwenden.
individualFullContractDecisions.wholeGoalContractEn: The learner can apply ethical models to questions of globalisation.
individualFullContractDecisions.wholeCaseAFinding: The supplied aggregate normative score12 versus9 is applied to known groups and contrasted with the actual rights limit against serious exit hazards. The model weights are stipulations, not objective welfare measurements. A justified recommendation and unknown consequences must be explained.
individualFullContractDecisions.wholeCaseBFinding: The same dataset is examined under15 versus11/200 versus170 outcomes and basic-access/participation criteria. Thirty deprived households and actual voice matter separately from totals. The independent resource/employment conflict supplies a genuine second variation.
individualFullContractDecisions.actualCurrentP2AndWholeExpectationFindin: Actual criteria/options/affected groups and resulting conflict are required in both cases. The material does not demand literal reproduction of P examples or treat ethical labels as application.

individualFullContractDecisions.wholeGoalContractDe: Die lernende Person kann CSR-Ansätze und Unternehmensethik im Kontext Globalisierung bewerten.
individualFullContractDecisions.wholeGoalContractEn: The learner can assess CSR approaches and business ethics in the context of globalisation.
individualFullContractDecisions.wholeCaseAFinding: Actual improved schooling is credited without erasing unsafe core operations. Changed purchasing, verified exits and18/20awareness are bounded implementation evidence; remaining accessibility and retaliation/future safety are open.
individualFullContractDecisions.wholeCaseBFinding: Per-unit intensity and total emissions are correctly separated. Independent totals/supply data and actual purchasing/water changes are compared with packaging claims; no unsupported voice or forced-labour improvement is inferred.
individualFullContractDecisions.actualCurrentP2AndWholeExpectationFindin: Both CSR variations judge criteria, implementation, actual effects and stakeholder/evidence limits. The material does not replace CSR performance by a donation total or a friendly label.

individualFullContractDecisions.wholeGoalContractDe: Die lernende Person kann menschenrechtliche Standards in globalen Lieferketten bewerten.
individualFullContractDecisions.wholeGoalContractEn: The learner can assess human-rights standards in global supply chains.
individualFullContractDecisions.wholeCaseAFinding: Concrete blocked exits and unsafe reporting require immediate protection, safe actual access, remedy and repeated independent check. Costs or a code alone prove neither protection nor future freedom from retaliation.
individualFullContractDecisions.wholeCaseBFinding: Actual fees, unwanted document retention and denied exit are evaluated against coercion protection. A signature is not free actual choice. Whole18000refund, documents/free exit and protected follow-up are required. Unknown buyer instruction is kept distinct from actual linkage and possible contribution.
individualFullContractDecisions.actualCurrentP2AndWholeExpectationFindin: Both full rights variants connect specific facts to standards, protection and effective remedy without claiming a national statute or automatic liability.

individualFullContractDecisions.wholeGoalContractDe: Die lernende Person kann Verantwortung von Unternehmen/Staaten/NGOs in globalen Lieferketten bewerten.
individualFullContractDecisions.wholeGoalContractEn: The learner can assess the responsibility of companies, states and NGOs in global supply chains.
individualFullContractDecisions.wholeCaseAFinding: Buyer/supplier contribution and influence, state protection/control and NGO evidence/representation are each judged with concrete powers and limits. Public failure does not excuse business and NGO is not public authority.
individualFullContractDecisions.wholeCaseBFinding: Buyer/supplier/recruiter, production/home states within actual jurisdiction and NGO safe representation are all explicit. Water community and workers test actual accountability; no global jurisdiction or unsupported NGO causation is inferred.
individualFullContractDecisions.actualCurrentP2AndWholeExpectationFindin: An independent second harm context has the actual three-group responsibility performance. Literal displacement wording in the P variant is not a compulsory copy; full contribution/influence/authority/remedy reasoning remains required.

fairnessFinding: The essential-performance limit prevents raw surplus in other sections licensing an entirely missing current goal performance. It does not require perfection: the actual alternative stop/repair recommendation, arithmetic error and concise but real partial reasoning remain passing at20. A genuinely applied second model and all three actually reasoned actor groups are essential to those whole contracts, not merely correct labels.
individualAssessmentMasteryBoundary: One complete chosen case may pass this material. It does not automatically master four curricular goals or certify two independent learner demonstrations; P2 remains an understanding contract and is not rewritten. Synthetic own counterworks are review probes, never observed learner/session evidence.
actualDEENMeaningFinding: All case facts, two models, options, monetary and emissions values, protection/remedy conditions, role boundaries and scoring criteria preserve meaning in EN. No additional English factual/legal claim found.
primarySummary: UNGP principles13/22 and commentary distinguish causing/contributing, direct linkage, remediation and legal liability. The amended2022ILOparagraph2(b)/(e) supplies the forced-labour and safety benchmarks. All companies, reports, outcomes and utility values remain fictional. No national-law/current-firm assertion is approved.
